Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A generic institutional records office maintains standardized intake registers. Each submitted item receives a unique case number, a filing date, and a routing field. Documents are logged upon receipt, reviewed for completeness, and indexed by date and applicant identifier. No substantive content is recorded in this section.

2) What occurred: On a dated day, the actor created an intake record in a shared communication channel with a second individual. On the same date, the actor added a payment field to a document. On a later date, the actor attached a set of relationship evidence documents to the record. On that later date, the actor marked a verification sign-off field as unverified. On a final date, the actor recorded an interview preparation session in a field. The payment field, the verification sign-off field, and the interview preparation field remained unverified in each instance.

3) Materials/access observed: The actor accessed a communication channel, a document repository, and a records management system. The actor observed a payment instrument, a set of relationship evidence documents, and an interview preparation document. The actor had write access to the intake record, the document repository, and the records management system.

4) Indicators & artifacts: A dated intake record containing a payment field. A set of relationship evidence documents dated within a narrow window. A verification sign-off field marked unverified. An interview preparation document. A communication channel log showing coordination between two individuals. A records management system entry with a missing verification sign-off.
